_note: Written BEFORE any run of this rule (no simulation, signal, band, order or trade computed). IN SAMPLE ONLY: the frame is read with ts < 2022-01-01; nothing dated 2022 or later is read.
frozen_name: ger40_noise30_xetra: the frozen us100 noise-area rule on the DAX's own cash clock
frozen_rule:
CLOCK AND DAYS: Europe/Berlin (DST from tz data). Xetra full trading days; skip 24 and 31 December and the day after an early close.

PRICES: mid. 'Price at T' = close of the M1 bar that starts at T-1 min. A check is skipped if the last quote is older than 10 min.

ANCHORS: O = open of the 09:00 bar. PC = close of the previous Xetra session's 17:29 bar.

CHECKS at T = 09:30, 10:00, ..., 17:00 (16 checks).
- sigma(T) = mean over the previous 14 sessions (at least 9 with data) of |P_d(T)/O_d - 1|.
- UB = max(O,PC) x (1 + sigma(T)); LB = min(O,PC) x (1 - sigma(T)).

STATE MACHINE, identical to noise30:
- flat and P(T) > UB: buy at market, stop at max(O,PC);
- flat and P(T) < LB: sell at market, stop at min(O,PC);
- long and P(T) < UB, or short and P(T) > LB: close at market.
- After a stop the state stays long or short (no re-entry) until a check passes the exit test.

EXIT: close everything at 17:25:00. One position at most.

SIZING: 1 R = |fill - stop|.

PARAMETERS: frozen from noise30 on us100 (lookback 14, band multiplier 1.0, step 30 min; results/r2/recalc/summary.json). Nothing is tuned on the DAX.
frozen_test_plan:
11 configurations. The verdict is read on (1) only.

(1) Main: frozen noise30 on the Xetra clock, as in 'rule'.

Neighbours (exit stays 17:25):
(2) look-back 11 sessions
(3) look-back 17 sessions
(4) band multiplier 0.8
(5) band multiplier 1.2
(6) check step 15 min
(7) check step 60 min
(8) first check 09:15
(9) first check 09:45

Stress: (10) main at costs x1.5.

Null: (11) the lab's null_test in mode 'day', 200 replays: same Berlin time on a random day, same side, stop and hold.

COST: ger40 frame (1.6 pt at 25,820 = 0.62 bp spread); market slippage 0.2 bp per side; stop fills 0.5 bp; no swap (flat by 17:25). About 1.0-1.3 bp per round trip.

PASS = PROTOCOL_V3 s.4 single-sleeve bars, plus one condition declared now: weekly R correlation with the sum of the ten at most 0.30 over 2014-2021.

REPORTED, NOT JUDGED:
- long and short R;
- R by year;
- R on entries where the move since the previous 17:30 close has |z| >= 1.5, against the rest (does this rediscover idx_eu trial 10?);
- the result on days when noise30 on us100 was flat.

Expected n about 1,400-1,600. If this passes in sample, the next tests are ger40_ocm4_xetra and the UK100 and AUS200 versions (the last two need data and FP spreads first).
frozen_instruments: ger40: FP cash CFD on the DAX, frame lab/data/fp/ger40_m1.parquet, 2013-09-30 to 2021. Xetra hours are present in every year.

param_legend.first_min: Berlin minute of the first check (570 = 09:30)
param_legend.last_min: Berlin minute of the last possible check (1020 = 17:00)
param_legend.exit_min: Berlin minute of the time exit (1045 = 17:25)

readings_of_open_details.R01_period: IN SAMPLE ONLY. The ger40 FP frame (lab/data/fp/ger40_m1.parquet) is read with the pyarrow row filter ts < 2022-01-01 00:00 UTC before anything else; that slice is passed explicitly to every simulation (goldlab.r2.load / evaluate / null_test are never called: they read the whole frame). Trades are counted for sessions from 2014-01-01 to 2021-12-31 (the judge's own figures and the correlation window are 2014-2021; noise30 itself starts 2014-01-01; the 2013 data are sparse, results/r2/idx_eu/report.txt s.1). The sessions of 2013-09-30 .. 2013-12-31 only warm up sigma (noise30's MIN_DATE logic).
readings_of_open_details.R02_clock: Europe/Berlin wall clock, DST from the tz database (pandas tz_localize / tz_convert per date).
readings_of_open_details.R03_sessions: Xetra sessions = weekdays that are not Xetra holidays. Holidays: the Deutsche Boerse cash-market calendar of the `holidays` package 0.108 (financial calendar XETR, 2016-2021: 1 Jan, Good Friday, Easter Monday, 1 May, Whit Monday and 3 October (holidays up to 2021 in that calendar), 24, 25, 26 and 31 December, and 2017-10-31), and the same rules for 2013-2015 (the package starts in 2016). Checked before this file: on these days the CFD frame has either no quote or thin, futures-like quotes, consistent with a closed Xetra.
readings_of_open_details.R04_early_close: 'Full trading days' only. The CFD frame cannot show whether Xetra closed at 14:00 on the last trading day of a year (it keeps quoting after 14:00). Conservative reading: the last session of every calendar year (the last weekday before 31 December that is not a holiday) is treated as an early close: it is not a full trading day, so it is neither traded nor a session of the grid (not in any sigma window, never a PC source).
readings_of_open_details.R05_skipped_days: Not traded (but kept as sessions for sigma, and as PC source): 24 and 31 December (holidays anyway); the session after an early close (= the first session of each year, R04); and, because the judge lists 24 December beside the early-close rule, the first session after a weekday 24 December (conservative reading: as if 24 December were an early close). Also no trade on a session without O (R07) or without PC (R07).
readings_of_open_details.R06_prices: mid = (bid + ask) / 2 of the FP frame. Price at T = mid close of the last M1 bar that STARTED before T (normally the bar starting at T-1 min); the check is skipped if that bar started more than 11 minutes before T, i.e. its close (= last quote) is more than 10 minutes old (noise30's grid, stale_min 10). The decision is executed at the OPEN of the first M1 bar starting at or after T if that bar starts at most 5 minutes after T (noise30's grid, late_min 5); otherwise the check is skipped.
readings_of_open_details.R07_anchors: O = mid OPEN of the M1 bar starting exactly at 09:00:00 Berlin (literal reading; noise30's grid accepted a first bar starting before 09:32 NY, the stricter literal reading is used: no 09:00 bar -> no trade that session). PC = price at 17:30 (mid close of the 17:29 bar, staleness rule R06) of the previous session of the grid. PC missing -> no trade that session (noise30's 'O alone' fallback was its early-close treatment, which this rule replaces by skipping the day after an early close; no undeclared fallback).
readings_of_open_details.R08_sigma: sigma(T) = mean over the previous L sessions of the grid (today excluded) of |P_d(T)/O_d - 1|, with at least max(int(0.7 L), 1) finite values: L=14 -> 9 (as declared), L=11 -> 7, L=17 -> 11 (noise30's code rule). Sessions without O or with a stale price at T count as missing values inside the window.
readings_of_open_details.R09_checks: Checks at T = first, first + step, ... <= 17:00 (noise30's np.arange(first, last + 1, step)); exit 17:25:00 for every configuration. Main 09:30..17:00 step 30 (16 checks); step 15: 09:30..17:00 (31); step 60: 09:30..16:30 (8; 17:00 is not on that grid); first 09:15: 09:15, 09:45 .. 16:45 (16); first 09:45: 09:45 .. 16:45 (15). A check whose execution bar is at or after the 17:25 exit bar is skipped.
readings_of_open_details.R10_state_machine: Identical to the frozen noise30 code (r2/tracks/idx_us/strategy.py::_noise), copied with the Berlin grid: UB = max(O, PC) (1 + vm sigma), LB = min(O, PC) (1 - vm sigma). At a check: if the state is long and P < UB, or short and P > LB: close at the open of the decision bar, state flat; then if flat and P > UB: buy, stop max(O, PC); if P < LB: sell, stop min(O, PC); an entry at the same check as an exit goes one bar later (noise30). After a stop the state stays long or short (no new entry) until a check passes the exit test. Everything closed at 17:25:00 (open of the first bar starting at or after 17:25; goldlab.exit_index closure rule). One position at most (simulate no_overlap=True).
readings_of_open_details.R11_costs: goldlab.sim.simulate on the in-sample slice with goldlab.r2.costs('ger40'): spread inside the FP frame (1.6 pt at 25,820 = 0.62 bp with Dukascopy's intraday shape), market fills (entries, check exits, the 17:25 exit) 0.2 bp per side, stop fills 0.5 bp, swap charged by the simulator per 17:00 New York rollover crossed (none expected: flat by 17:25 Berlin; checked). Config 10: spread and slippage x1.5, orders rebuilt on the widened quotes (goldlab.r2.run 'stress' logic: apply_spread_mult(1.5) + r2.costs('ger40', 1.5)).
readings_of_open_details.R12_three_spreads: Broker rule: a trade whose initial stop is closer to its fill than 3 spreads (ask open - bid open of its fill bar, on the frame of the run) is refused, as is a trade whose stop is already crossed at the fill: its order is removed and the configuration re-simulated until no taken trade violates it (convention of the breadth lens, r2/tracks/autopsy/breadth/common.py). Applied in fp and x1.5 runs, not in the gross run. Count reported.
readings_of_open_details.R13_R: 1 R = |fill - initial stop| (simulator). PF, t, expectancy on per-trade R (goldlab.metrics.report).
readings_of_open_details.R14_every_signal: Every-signal expectancy: the same (filtered) orders simulated with no_overlap=False. The state machine never emits an order while its own previous order is open, so it should equal the main run; computed anyway (part of config 1's line).
readings_of_open_details.R15_gross: Gross run of config 1 (bid = ask = mid, no slippage, no swap; goldlab.r2 'gross' logic): information only, stored in config 1's line as goldlab.r2.evaluate does; not a configuration and judges nothing.
readings_of_open_details.R16_null: Config 11: the algorithm of goldlab.r2.null_test, mode 'day', 200 replays, seed 0, re-implemented on the in-sample slice with the Berlin minute of day: every taken trade of config 1 (FP costs, entries 2014-2021) is re-entered AT MARKET at a random bar with the same Berlin minute of day, drawn among all bars of the slice (frame start 2013-09-30 .. 2021-12-31, as the lab's _minute_groups), with the same side, the same stop distance relative to price (scaled at the random entry's mid) and the same time-exit delay in bars (planned exit of the order: its check exit or 17:25), one position at a time, FP costs, no 3-spread filter (the lab's null has none), entries kept if before 2022-01-01. Pass: the rule's mean R above the 97.5th percentile of the 200 replay means (share of replays strictly below >= 0.975).
readings_of_open_details.R17_correlation: Extra condition: weekly sums of R by calendar week of the EXIT (pandas W = Monday-Sunday, UTC), every week from the week of 2014-01-01 to the week of 2021-12-31 counted (empty weeks = 0), Pearson correlation of config 1 (FP costs) with the sum of the ten official sleeves (results/r2/recalc/trades/<name>__<sym>.parquet read with the filters entry_time < 2022-01-01 AND exit_time < 2022-01-01 in the same statement). Conservative reading of 'at most 0.30': |rho| <= 0.30. Also reported (not judged): each cluster (us100 = noise30 + ocm4; gold = GOLD_FRI_PM + donch4h_stop + orb_asia_2d_buf10; crypto = brk72_24h_wd btc + eth, F1_brk_ridge_filter btc + eth, nq_btc_follow) and each sleeve.
readings_of_open_details.R18_years: Years = calendar years of the entry, 2014..2021 (8 years); >= 60 % positive means at least 5 of 8 (goldlab.r2.is_criteria: yp >= 0.6 yn).
readings_of_open_details.R19_reported_not_judged: long and short R; R by year; R of entries whose move since the previous 17:30 close has |z| >= 1.5 against the rest, z = (P(T)/PC - 1) / sd, sd = sample standard deviation (ddof 1) of (P(T)/PC - 1) at the same check time over the previous 20 sessions that have a value (20 required; idx_eu strategy._mom, trial 10's definition), entries with no z counted apart; the result on days when noise30 on us100 was flat (no official noise30 trade entered on that New York date; official file read as in R17); counts of trades on the first session after Whit Monday / 3 October / 2017-10-31 (calendar check). Information only.
readings_of_open_details.R20_causality: Truncation test on at least 50 decisions of config 1 (fixed seed 7): 40 entries and 30 check exits drawn among the 2014-2021 decisions; the in-sample slice is cut at the execution bar of the decision (every bar starting at or after the check time T removed), 3 provisional bars are appended at the real times of the next bars (three variants: flat at the last close, +3 %, -3 %), the orders are rebuilt; the decision must be identical in all variants (entry: same entry bar, side and stop; check exit: same exit bar of the open order) and the set of orders decided at or before T must be identical to the full frame's.
readings_of_open_details.R21_neighbours: Neighbours = configs 2..9 (FP costs); their median PF must be >= 1.06.

pass_criteria_main.years_pos>=60%: config 1: at least 5 of the 8 entry years 2014-2021 with total R > 0
pass_criteria_main.max_hold<=5d: config 1 max hold <= 5 trading days (goldlab.r2.is_criteria: max_hold_h <= 192)
